maintenance_led.reason: Ceiling tiles and grid are mostly sold for renovation and replacement of existing commercial ceilings, rather than new construction.

publicly_funded.reason: Ceiling and wall products are sold through distributors to private commercial building owners and contractors. Schools and hospitals are only part of the market.

serial_acquirer.reason: It grows by selling its own ceiling and wall products, with only occasional acquisitions such as metal and wood specialty makers.

mission_critical.reason: Ceiling tiles and grid are standard building products, and competitors such as USG and Rockfon offer substitutes, so switching is easy.

notes: The renovation share comes from my own knowledge, not the website text. Mission-critical is a borderline call because of specification and fire-rating requirements.
